services.name: Private Bay Cruise on Luxury Boat
services.desc: Looking for a day in the sun, or just want to get on the water in San Diego? Welcome aboard the Nimbus. Your private party can enjoy cruising around Mission Bay in style and comfort. Perfect for special occasions and memorable moments. The Nimbus is 37 feet of space equipped with plenty of cushioned seating, a private head (restroom), a killer Sirius sound system, and a stable ride at both slow and (very!) fast speeds. We provide light snacks, water, and Gatorade. You are welcome to bring a picnic lunch and any beverages you desire... just no glass. services.name: Private Whale and Wildlife Viewing
services.desc: Hop aboard our luxurious boat, The Nimbus, and set out in search of local wildlife. Your private tour for up to 6 people is on the most stable and comfortable boat around. Did we mention there's a private head (restroom)? Our captains are local experts, experienced voyagers, coast guard certified, and the friendliest of crew. Kick back on cushioned chairs enjoy some complementary snacks and beverages while playful dolphins dance in the boats wake. Watch sea lions wrestle and shove for the best spot on rocks and buoys.
